title: What is the GenStone Pro Program? - GenStone
text:
What is the GenStone Pro Program?

The GenStone Pro Program is built for builders, remodelers, and contractors looking to add high-margin stone projects without the labor, delays, or complexity of traditional masonry. The program includes Pro pricing, project renderings, quote support, and installation guidance designed to help you win and complete more jobs.
